<instructions>
<!-- EXEC_SUMMARY_PROMPT_JUDGE_ALIGNED_V10 - consolidated I0 (arc/judge/calibration deduped) -->

<third_person_voice_contract>
**CRITICAL (X2 hard-fail):** `resume_display_text` and `executive_strategy_thesis` are third-person executive résumé prose only.
FORBIDDEN tokens: I, me, my, mine, we, our, us. FORBIDDEN openers: "As an SVP", "As a", "In this role I", "My leadership", "I have", "I align".
</third_person_voice_contract>

<six_sentence_period_contract>
**CRITICAL (X2 hard-fail):** `resume_display_text` = **exactly six** sentences, period-terminated (`.`). Count by periods only.
Max **two** Led/Designed/Implemented/Built/Generated openers in S2-S5; prefer connective bridges when causality is real.
</six_sentence_period_contract>

<approved_non_stock_openers>
**S2–S5 transitions (compile advisory):** Prefer approved non-stock openers when varying rhythm:
- From that commercial base,
- Against that lineage backdrop,
- In parallel,
- That operating foundation also,
- The same platform discipline,
</approved_non_stock_openers>

<proof_law_v1>
Proof: C0 + ALLOWED_SOURCE_FACT_IDS only (pa_proof_binding_v1 / pa_targeting_only_v1). Clean display prose; no [source:...] tags. X2 gates: PRODUCT_SHAPE.
fit_to_evidence: every displayed claim must map to an allowed fact or claim_ledger row; unsupported fit/targeting language must be omitted.
</proof_law_v1>

<source_fact_id_tokens>
Pattern: bul_unify_003 valid when listed; bul_unify_ 003 invalid (spacing drift fails X2).
</source_fact_id_tokens>

<credential_policy_v1>
No trailing cert inventory, employer-name lines, or AWS/Databricks/FSA label stacks in display prose. One woven credibility clause allowed when fact-backed.
</credential_policy_v1>

<display_metric_weave_contract>
**CRITICAL (X1D executive_signal):** judges read `resume_display_text`, not claim_ledger alone - when a
cited allowed fact carries a dollar/percent/headcount outcome, weave that VALUE into the matching display
sentence in plain prose (not a metric list), weighted to S3-S5; never park metrics only in claim_ledger.
**Allowed-fact utilization (X2):** surface the metric VALUES present in THIS run's ALLOWED_SOURCE_FACT_IDS -
do not skip a required allowed metric for an abstract phrase.
**Brushstroke coverage (X2 hard-fail):** the C0 composition plan may mark B1/B2/B3/B4 brushstrokes with
`required_fact_ids`. Cite at least one required fact from EVERY non-empty brushstroke group across the
six `claim_ledger` rows. S1 / `executive_strategy_thesis` must include and cite the B1 executive-identity
required fact when B1 is present; do not replace it with a stronger-looking Unify or IBM fact.
**Hardcoded-figure ban (X2 north_star_style_echo):** NEVER emit a $/percent/headcount unless it appears in a
cited allowed fact for THIS run - never copy a figure or its outcome phrase from an E0 style example (examples
are domain-transposed and non-literal; retrieve real values from ALLOWED_SOURCE_FACT_IDS).
On SVP IT strategy lanes frame revenue/margin outcomes as "IP-led revenue growth / margin expansion /
monetization of platform IP" - NEVER the literal word "commercialization" (X2 hard-fails it on strategy lanes).
</display_metric_weave_contract>

<judge_alignment_contract>
**Synthesis target (X1D):** one leadership arc - not six bullets. JD/briefing are targeting vocabulary only; no JD-as-proof; leadership stays primary; **no verbatim JD phrase (no ≥3-word JD run, e.g. "with gsi and cloud partner") - X2 jd_phrase_copy**; no TARGET_COMPANY employment.
**Keyword discipline:** ATS and JD keywords may tune wording only; no keyword stuffing, laundry-list targeting, or keyword-only fit claims.
**Workflow:** (1) Read C0 + allowlist; JD/briefing for emphasis only. (2) Write `executive_strategy_thesis` (one sentence, allowed facts). (3) Write six-sentence `resume_display_text` advancing that thesis; S1 paraphrases thesis (never verbatim copy).
**S1:** Sharp executive leadership register (EA governance, innovation programs, operating model) - not generic "regulated enterprise scale." S1 paraphrases `executive_strategy_thesis` - NEVER include a thesis thread (e.g. "commercialization") unless at least one S2–S6 body sentence substantiates that thread with an allowed source_fact_id; an undelivered S1 promise is a `thesis_body_gap` that soft-fails Claude-class judges. **S1 is a strategic-register sentence, NOT a mechanism comma-list (X2 no_mechanism_inventory): ≤1 mechanism in S1, never a 3+ comma-stack.**
**S2-S3:** Platform/operating-model substance; connective causal thread when honest; surface allowed metric VALUES in display per the metric-weave contract above.
**S4:** Governance/lineage as parallel beat with an allowed outcome metric in display when one is cited; no forced "extended to" bridges across unrelated facts. On SVP strategy lanes with ≥3 brushstrokes, use a non-stock opener here (e.g. `In parallel,` / `That operating foundation also,`) - both stock-bridge slots are expected to be consumed in S2–S3.
**S4 sentence completeness:** S4 MUST be a complete sentence with a finite main verb, never a noun-phrase fragment. Use the DISPLAY_OVERRIDE text for fact_quant_hpc_003 verbatim if provided.
**S5:** One quantitative-rigor clause with an allowed percent/outcome in display; no derivatives/multi-Greek/Towers Perrin/ING/Aetna/FSA inventory; no meta ("rather than listing credentials").
**S2–S5 connective tissue:** Open S2-S5 with thesis-referent connectors, not bare achievement-verb openers; avoid an achievement bullet stack.
**S6:** Forward capstone grounded in cited source_fact_ids; may use composition_plan TARGETING_FORWARD_ANCHOR as targeting-only. Forbid "Looking ahead," "extend that arc toward", "this leadership profile", "can translate into", S2-S5 recap, and unsupported "audit/audit-ready." Open with modal/future-forward language, not past-tense delivery verbs.
**Connectives:** At most **two** stock openers (`Building on` / `Through that` / `Complementing` / `With that governance` / `Against that` / `From that`) in S2-S5; vary bridge nouns. On SVP strategy lanes with ≥3 brushstrokes, S4 MUST use a non-stock opener.
**Meta-filler ban:** no "governance discipline", "active-voice delivery", "selected facts" scaffolding.
**SRFS forbidden phrases (X2):** "reusable platform services adopted across enterprise programs", "engineering scale-out", "bespoke delivery", "converting bespoke delivery".
U0 `narrative_arc_weights` = thematic emphasis only (weighting, not a per-sentence fact-count directive). claim_ledger: emit **exactly one row per displayed sentence** (one-to-one - 6 rows for the S1-S6 summary), each tracing to an allowed fact.
</judge_alignment_contract>

<composition_heuristics>
One paragraph; write **110-130 words** - deterministic post-processing may inject a required bridge sentence and the X2 hard ceiling is **150** words AFTER those additions. Third person; no U+2014 em dash. Voice examples: E0 at execute time.
</composition_heuristics>

<internal_deliberation_controls>
Derive thesis internally; do not output chain-of-thought or deliberation text.
</internal_deliberation_controls>

<self_check_requirements>
Verify before return (six fields only - X2 gates enforce the rest deterministically):
executive_strategy_thesis_present; jd_used_as_proof_false; s6_forward_synthesis_not_recap;
material_metrics_surfaced_in_display_rows_3_4_5; every_material_claim_in_claim_ledger.
</self_check_requirements>

</instructions>

- S5: when fact_quant_hpc_003 (FSA/quant foundation) and fact_quant_hpc_001 are cited together, weave the allowed stress-testing/HPC outcome percent into display (not ledger-only); forbidden: derivatives / multi-Greek / employer inventory lists.
- S6: forward capstone grounded in source_fact_ids — MUST project what the candidate's proven capabilities enable in the SVP IT Strategy & AI Enablement context (e.g. federate governed platforms, accelerate M&A integration, build enterprise innovation programs at scale); may use composition_plan s6_targeting_forward_anchor (briefing/JD emphasis only); forbidden: 'Looking ahead,' opener, 'extend that arc toward' recap, 'this leadership profile', 'can translate into', and closing on a backward-looking technical tool description with no forward projection.

- NEVER name TARGET_COMPANY in resume_display_text.
